entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `UnionCaseTypes` Reports a Nullable Value Type as `NotAnnotated` #85269
  • It looks like `InConversionGroupFlags.UserDefinedReturnTypeAdjustment` is never actually used #85267
  • CA1517 false positive when span elements are mutated via `foreach (ref var ...)` #85266
  • CS0177 and CS0161 generated despite switch being exhaustive over union #85265
  • Concurrent shared compilations can fail releasing the client mutex on Linux #85264
  • Remove workaround in TestFileBasedProgram_PackageRestoreWithExplicitArtifactsPath #85258
    18.12

Closed

  • C# compiler should not report CS8780 on receiving variable in switch on union w/ generic type #85270
  • It looks like condition determining applicability of `RewriteArgumentsForComCall` in `ExtractSideEffectsFromArguments` doesn't handle extension block members #84735
    18.A
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-12211.24 #85259
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-12209.490 #85246

PullRequests

Created

  • Route faults through the current telemetry instance #85273
    VSCode
  • Move the LanguageServerProjectLoader over to our priority queue #85272
    VSCode
  • Support MTP in language server test runs #85271
    VSCode
  • Let F# keep per-document data in Roslyn's persistent storage #85268
    Community
  • Avoid Enum.HasFlag boxing in the compilers #85263
  • Improve IOperation shape for a cast utilizing user-defined conversions #85262
    Area-Compilers
  • Consolidate warn-as-error flags in build scripts #85261
    Area-Infrastructure
  • File-based apps: load #:ref projects #85260
    VSCode
  • Let Peek Definition ask another language for a metadata symbol's source #85257
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Use consistent keyword style for discards in symbol displays #85256

Merged

  • Add semantic test attribute discovery option #85255
    VSCode, Next
  • Handle COM extension-block indexers in compound assignments #85212
    Next
  • Make CI test payload artifacts retry-safe #85248
    Next
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3068534 #85101
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3071758 #85243
  • Fix compiler server logging #85193
    Area-Compilers, Next

Updated

  • Avoid cache misses due to cancellation in deprioritized analyzer cache #85222
    VSCode
  • Upgrade to xUnit v3 #85249
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Remove EditorConfigGenerator external access layer #85207
  • Remove team specific ExternalAccess assemblies #85135
    Needs API Review, VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Add on-demand project loading #85234
    VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: display `unsafe` modifier on interface members too #85118
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • [breaking-change] Treat partial consistently as a modifier #85094
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Unify contextual type declaration lookahead #84936
    Area-Compilers, Community, VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: fix `new()` constraint handling in declarations #84888
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • [C# preview] Allow 'partial' in any modifier position #85147
    Area-Compilers, Community, Needs UX Triage, VSCode, Feature - Relax modifier ordering, Area-Razor
  • Set LanguageServer and BuildHost handles to not be inheritable #85120
    VSCode
  • Update to .NET 11 RC1 #85228
    VSCode
  • Add exclude_single_letter_parameters option to CA1704 #85161
    Community
  • Don't report CA1704 for numeric type parameter names (T1, T2, …) #85162
    Area-Analyzers, Community
  • [C# preview] Allow 'ref' in any type modifier position #85148
    Area-Compilers, Community, Needs UX Triage, VSCode, Feature - Relax modifier ordering, Area-Razor
  • Restore the built-in VS SDK .pkgdef generation and migrate to it #85231
    VSCode, Area-Razor
